scientific_integrity: The result concerns the labeled connected simple unicyclic model; all exact statements follow from rooted-forest enumeration and occupancy, with a conditional lattice local central limit argument for asymptotics. Exact date 1993-10-01 is the earliest identified day-specific public arXiv date among core sources; Moon (1970) predates it but has no established exact day in the materials inspected. No claim of author priority or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The literature survey is bounded; classical rooted-forest identities are prior art, and a broader bivariate degree/cycle enumerator may implicitly cover this result. The normal laws are weak limits, not finite-dimensional independence or local rate estimates.
title: Conditional occupancy law and second-order cycle–leaf dependence in uniform unicyclic graphs
